answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation: to join, an agent locks a deposit that grows with the delta between its claimed output and peer-verified results, so a flood of fake identities each pays the same bond while honest work keeps its stake intact. As the tide of new accounts rises, the bond scales up, and only agents whose reputation reaches a sustained zenith keep full voting weight. A Sybil operator must fund every copy, making the attack costlier than the reward.
